rows.description: A young adult keeps hearing that they should marry by a certain age and choose a certain course; the receiver may feel love and pressure together and needs a way to keep both respect and their own choice.

rows.description: A child who takes longer with reading calls themselves dumb and stops trying; a single label replaces a specific skill that can be practised.

rows.subtype: Labelling others in a bad moment [Actor]
